acceptanceCriteria: recipeId, cultureId, trayId, zoneId, batchId and all enum-like fields use SINGLE_CHOICE or MULTI_CHOICE as appropriate; dynamic options can be attached without violating ScreenField invariants.
Zone types use exact stable IDs natural_light, grow_light and dark; theme options system, light and dark remain distinct; all other enum IDs exactly match ProductionScreenDataManager parsing.

Every registry field, option and action emits a specific stable TextKey describing its actual concept; no unknown field/action silently falls back to field_recipe/action_edit and no distinct theme option aliases to system.
Tests enumerate all registry keys, assert selector kinds and stable option IDs, and prove representative create/edit command preparation still matches manager operations.
No data, Compose resource, UI, platform, build, ledger or external service changes; specialist does not run Gradle.
goal: Make the typed screen registry semantically exact for model-driven UI: selectors must use choice kinds with stable domain option IDs, every field/option/action must emit a specific production TextKey, and registry preparation must stay compatible with every ProductionScreenDataManager operation.
